value.rationale: The original 2021 paper explicitly asks about torsion in tournament-neighborhood homology. This complete exact eight-vertex census advances the proven necessary order from at least eight to at least nine, while furnishing the entire 26-type integral homology spectrum and a unique sharp first-Betti extremum for 6880 natural isomorphism classes. The cutoff is the next mathematical boundary after the known n<=7 theorem, not an ad hoc sample. No downstream theorem or full homotopy classification is asserted.
